verdict.rationale: Phoenix has explicit Prompt Management features supporting versioning, storage, and deployment of prompts, plus 'Prompts in Code' SDKs to sync prompts across environments so changes can be pushed to production without code changes. Docs show a UI-based prompt playground and versioning workflow decoupled from application code deploys. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification beyond vendor docs of production rollback/rollout mechanics and no explicit mention of environment-specific staged rollout controls.
